comment: Shared-object names that appear in a composed root's binaries and are NOT carried.
Each class carries the reason that explains every member, so the next run's unexplained
count is the finding rather than the whole list re-derived by hand.
THE SIGNATURE OF THE LARGEST CLASS IS MECHANICAL: a binary that names TWO VERSIONS of one
library is not depending on either, it is asking which is there -- libbpf 0 and 1,
libqrencode 3 and 4, seven readline sonames for one line-editing feature.
THIS SCAN IS A NECESSARY CONDITION AND NOT A PROOF, and the proof of that is in this root:
openssl's providers live in a DIRECTORY READ BY NAME (ossl-modules), so the carried
legacy.so provider appears in neither the found nor the missing list. A name assembled at
run time or a directory scanned for whatever is in it is invisible here.

systemd optional features.reason: dlopened by libsystemd-shared and degraded when absent: TPM2, FIDO2, BPF firewalling, QR codes, password quality, compressed journals. Not used on these devices.

line editors probed by libss.reason: e2fsprogs' subsystem library offers line editing to debugfs if it finds any of these; none is carried and debugfs works without it.

podman optional backends.reason: krun's VM hypervisor and the historical journald soname spellings podman probes. libsystemd.so.0 itself IS carried; the unversioned and split names never existed here.

loader and glibc internals.reason: the dynamic loader's own names, glibc's optional IDN support, and dev-style unversioned spellings that no package ships. Includes fragments the regex catches out of string tables, which is the aperture being wide enough rather than a defect.

other optional features.reason: probed by one tool each and absent by choice: ncurses' mouse support, procps' NUMA reporting, and the library ischroot looks for to detect a fakechroot.
